cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sit down, love; I've made your tea. No reminder needed, unlike my birthday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've brought cake. A month late, I know.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your favourite, too. I'll cut you a proper slice; the birthday girl can have the corner. I've still got the candle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Put it in your slice. I'll sing now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll hold the plate up for you, love. A month of waiting and I finally get to hear it.

reason: Make A lead the tea and yield the birthday slice to B repair offer; retain caring service with a grievance in every A turn, using the established month delay rather than a new last-year call.
